content.text: Imagine you're a digital creator in Zimbabwe, where PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-5|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] have been blocked for years. Your ebook sales rely on Gumroad, which takes 10% of every sale, but NOWPayments charges just 0.5%. This fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-7|difference]] adds up quickly, retaining $921 per month at 100 sales. What if you could sell ebooks online without these middlemen, with a system of your own, built to last, and with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|The Full]] sovereignty?

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

When choosing a solution, consider the tools you have at your disposal. Gumroad, for instance, provides a user-friendly interface, but it's limited to certain payment gateways. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) offers a full-fledged digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means you're in control of your infrastructure, free from platform restrictions and fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
COREMERCH's infrastructure is built to last, with a focus on sovereignty and customization.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to ask is, 'Can I sell ebooks online without relying on platforms like Gumroad or PayPal?' The answer is yes, you can, with a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack or Sovereign Starter Stack. These solutions provide a full-fledged digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
With COREMERCH, you can sell ebooks online without relying on traditional payment gateways or middlemen.

For those interested in learning more about sovereign commerce infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a comprehensive solution, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, worth $348 separately. COREMERCH's approach to digital commerce has been pressure-tested in the face of payment restrictions and currency collapses. Visit their shop to explore the products and solutions that can help you sell digital products online without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Your Deployment Checklist

To build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the necessary blueprints and templates. Choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) as your infrastructure solution. Configure your digital store, automation processes, and product delivery according to your specific requirements. Test and validate your architecture to ensure seamless payment processing and delivery. Launch your digital store and start selling ebooks online without relying on middlemen.

To set up automatic crypto payment processing, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen infrastructure solution. This typically involves creating a webhook that fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, triggering the delivery of your digital products.
Can I customize my digital store and automation processes with COREMERCH's infrastructure?

Yes, with COREMERCH's infrastructure, you have full ownership and control over your digital store, automation processes, and product delivery. This means you can customize your architecture to suit your specific requirements.
What happens if I encounter issues with payment processing or delivery with COREMERCH's infrastructure?

In the unlikely event of issues with payment processing or delivery, COREMERCH offers 30-day support for their infrastructure solutions. Additionally, their documentation and community resources can help you troubleshoot and resolve any problems.
Can I use COREMERCH's infrastructure to sell digital products in restricted countries?

Yes, COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to serve creators in regions with strict payment restrictions, such as Nigeria or Ghana. Their solutions cater to local needs and bypass traditional payment gateways.
